‼️ I urged the National Cancer Institute to renew its Cancer Center Support Grant to help @UAZCancer conduct cancer research and treatment for Arizona's cancer patients.
https://t.co/tGR1nA1F4X

Monica from our office attended a ribbon cutting for @HospicePromise1 in Glendale, Arizona. Hospice Promise provides end-of-life care to their patients. Thank you for taking care of our community. https://t.co/f3APLRRYcu
I voted YES to lower health care costs for all patients, including those with diabetes. Sadly, DEMOCRATS blocked this important provision.

I’m a cosponsor of @RepMGriffith's Patient Access to Urgent-Use Pharmacy Compounding Act to ensure hospitals and physicians’ offices can obtain the urgent medicines that are needed when they are unavailable from manufacturers or outsourcing facilities.
https://t.co/dy7SdNAv11

Patients and their doctors should determine which health care option is best for them. To give patients greater control over health care decisions, I cosponsored the DOC Access Act.
https://t.co/E9zxB0Md7v

House Democrats’ radical H.R. 8294 allows abortion pills to be mailed out to patients. These drugs are deemed high-risk and can cause DEATH. This is just another abortion-on-demand scheme funded by taxpayers that endangers the health and safety of women and girls.

Monica from our office presented a Congressional Recognition to @hopeteamaz in Goodyear, AZ. Hope Team helps cancer patients stay busy with enriching activities such as sporting events & dinners. Thank you for all you do for the patients of the @CancerCenter! https://t.co/xqhK5EOx9M

Arizona is proud to be home to over four million organ donors, but there is still a shortage of organ donors across our nation. Consider becoming an organ donor today to help save the lives of patients who desperately need organ transplants. @DonateLifeAZ

Monica from our office presented a Congressional Recognition for @BannerHealth Sun Health Research Institute in Sun City, AZ, for its groundbreaking research and care for patients with Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s! https://t.co/oDuEiNijK5

Monica from our office presented a Congressional Recognition to Assistance in Healthcare in Goodyear, AZ for helping cancer patients cover the cost of bills such as mortgages, rent, utilities, childcare, and more. We are so grateful for your contributions to the people of AZ-08! https://t.co/X2OB3WwmQ1

Monica from our office attended a community partnership breakfast hosted by the Southwest Valley Chamber of Commerce and officials from Goodyear, AZ to learn more about the @AmDiabetesAssn and how patients manage diabetes. https://t.co/t8ByD3qQbv

Monica from our office presented a Congressional Recognition to @AngelFlightWest, a group of volunteer pilots who fly patients to medical appointments and relocate domestic violence victims at no cost to the passengers. Thank you for supporting Arizonans in need! https://t.co/0OZCStaqBg

November is Alzheimer’s Awareness Month. With over six million Americans living with Alzheimer’s, we must support patients and their families as we work to find a cure and #EndAlz. https://t.co/nwYIBll43R

Providing better healthcare for our military families is the least we can do to thank our servicemembers for their sacrifices.

Honored to sponsor legislation that will bring TRICARE coverage in line with private insurance plans.

Monica from our office presented a Congressional Recognition to @RockStdyBoxing in Phoenix, AZ, which provides non-contact boxing classes to Parkinson’s patients so they can become independent. We appreciate their contributions to our district! https://t.co/6jVqbAjvqf
Great to meet with @IAFaccess to discuss increasing access to important infusion medication for patients. https://t.co/0FAdD8bndm

I am outraged by what I heard in @COVIDSelect from witnesses whose parents died in New York nursing homes from COVID-19, & then New York covered up the deaths! The DOJ should investigate Cuomo for forcing nursing homes to take in COVID-19 positive patients and for his cover-ups. https://t.co/Ek5Cm35gwf
My @HouseCommerce colleagues and I are hard at work to assess the challenges facing patients and doctors so that we can focus on the implementation of quality health care. https://t.co/lEpdxLexq1

Monica from our office presented a Congressional Recognition to @StellasWishFnd, a nonprofit from Sun City West, AZ that grants wishes to cancer patients locally and around the country. We are grateful for their unwavering dedication to the community. https://t.co/6x9ZXVqIPB

I’m pleased to be partnering with @RepBradWenstrup to cosponsor the Safe Step Act. This legislation will help both doctors and patients in ensuring we continue to offer the best medical care possible for each patient. https://t.co/526tCSw1yc

Today, I had the opportunity to meet with @WLGore to discuss ways Congress can continue to help the healthcare industry to ensure patients and their families can receive the best outcomes possible. Their facility is a valued part of #AZ08! https://t.co/V4kqmNo12i

Thank you to the @ACSCANAZ for presenting me with the “Cancer Hero” Award! I’m a proud cosponsor of the Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act, which improves coverage for early-detection cancer tests. https://t.co/hqNyvQqHsY

The last thing cancer patients should be concerned with is comparing costs. I’m pleased to sponsor the Medicare Patient Access to Cancer Treatment Act. This legislation will help to preserve access to community oncology care and keep prices as low as possible.
https://t.co/aZmjuwk3bC

It was great meeting with @soleohealth to discuss the many healthcare services they offer in the district and what Congress can do to help them continue providing patients with valuable in-home treatment options. https://t.co/Iv5FAByMpX

It was a pleasure meeting with the @LungAssociation to discuss the important work they do to fight against lung cancer and support healthier outcomes for patients battling cancer and other respiratory diseases. https://t.co/6K5FeaTrzG
